title: Equity Orbit
body: Built a multi-desk platform connecting charting, forecasts, market data and order entry through shared authentication and broker integrations.
detail: Engineering: PostgreSQL workflows and forecast snapshots; GitHub Actions, Vitest and Playwright release checks.
stack: React / Vite | Express | PostgreSQL | Python | SignalR
caption: Equity Orbit home page

title: Offline Document Retrieval (RAG)
body: Built a local assistant with OCR, vision captions, vector + BM25 search, cross-encoder reranking and a local 9B language model.
detail: Evaluation: 70-question suite, including 25 cases with expected sources; incremental indexing and cited answers.
caption: Pipeline settings preview

title: Transformer Training Lab
body: Implemented a 4.83M-parameter decoder-only Transformer with six blocks, eight attention heads and Apple MPS acceleration.
detail: Recorded run: 10,000 steps on Tiny Shakespeare; validation loss 4.34 to 1.65. Added loss charts and attention heatmaps.
caption: Training ledger and validation loss

title: Graph Finance Engine
body: Modeled assets, sectors, factors and portfolios in Neo4j, with interactive graph exploration and portfolio exposure analysis.
detail: Engineering: PageRank, centrality, communities and shortest paths; guarded Cypher queries with timeouts and result limits.
stack: FastAPI | Neo4j | NetworkX | React / TypeScript | three.js
caption: Graph view - sample dataset

title: Physics Lab
body: Built interactive physics and geometry simulations with live equations, including Circle constructions and quantum orbital views.
detail: Verification: Repository includes 181 automated checks: 168 physics tests, including analytic checks, plus 13 formatting tests.
